rules.rule:
This is a Next.js 16 App Router project using shadcn/ui (new-york style, radix base) and Tailwind CSS v4.

Before commenting on UI code, READ these project documents so your review is grounded in the actual conventions:
- .agents/skills/shadcn/SKILL.md
- .agents/skills/shadcn/rules/styling.md
- .agents/skills/shadcn/rules/composition.md
- .agents/skills/shadcn/rules/icons.md
- content/pages/branding/cast.mdx (the ONLY source of palette/theme colors)

MANDATORY UI RULES (violations are real bugs, not style nits):
1. Use semantic shadcn tokens, never raw colors: bg-primary, text-muted-foreground, border-border, bg-card, text-card-foreground, bg-accent, text-accent-foreground. NO bg-blue-500, NO text-gray-600, NO hex values in component className/style. The palette lives in app/globals.css as CSS variables derived from cast.mdx; theme tokens come FROM the cast palette.
2. className is for LAYOUT ONLY (max-w-md, mx-auto, mt-4, flex, gap-*, grid). Never use className to override component colors or typography. Use built-in variants (variant='outline', variant='secondary') or semantic tokens instead.
3. No space-x-* or space-y-* anywhere. Use flex gap-* / flex flex-col gap-*.
4. Use size-* when width == height (size-10 not w-10 h-10). Use truncate shorthand.
5. Full shadcn Card composition required: CardHeader/CardTitle/CardDescription/CardContent/CardFooter. Never dump headings/paragraphs directly into CardContent. Card internal spacing is controlled by the --card-spacing CSS variable, NEVER by py-0/p-0/gap-0 overrides.
6. Use cn() from @/lib/utils for conditional class names, never template-literal ternaries.
7. Avatar always needs AvatarFallback.
8. No manual z-index on overlay components (Dialog/Sheet/DropdownMenu/Popover handle their own stacking).
9. No manual dark: overrides — semantic tokens handle themes.
10. Use components over custom markup: Separator not <hr>, Skeleton not animate-pulse, Badge not styled span, Alert for callouts.
11. Icons inside Button use data-icon='inline-start'|'inline-end' via lucide-react components; no sizing classes on icons inside components.
12. Textures (cork, felt, cardboard, denim, woven, notebook paper) come from brand-assets.css CSS variables/utility classes (bg-cork, bg-woven, card-paper, grade-surface, cast-surface). Do NOT invent new texture classes; do NOT use hero images where a repeating texture is the design pattern.
13. Tailwind v4 breakpoints: default sm=640/md=768/lg=1024/xl=1280 ONLY. No custom breakpoints, no clamp()/vw for padding or gap.
14. Responsive layout uses max-w-* + mx-auto utilities, never custom container classes.
15. Buttons with a route link use Button asChild wrapping a next/link Link. Do not hand-roll button styling.

Also enforce the generic checks (typos, dead code, duplicate code, hardcoded business strings, var/== bans).

Tailwind v4 theme file. Custom CSS is limited to brand identity surfaces (hero navy surface, paper panels, cast accent borders, texture backgrounds). Semantic tokens are derived FROM the cast.mdx palette. Never scatter raw hex into components. The @theme block maps CSS variables to Tailwind utilities — any custom color used as a utility (bg-wood-warm, text-wood-muted, etc.) MUST be registered in the @theme block or the utility silently won't exist. Do not add @property rules that break Tailwind v4 PostCSS. Use data-* variants and inline styles for animated CSS vars.

These are installed shadcn/ui components and are the authoritative API. Do not flag them for rewrite. If a component lacks a needed variant (e.g. accent), extend the local component file per shadcn conventions — never re-add via npx (overwrites local changes), never fetch raw GitHub.
